caption: A 2–3–1 network with two weight-carrying layers. The labels give the weights and biases counted on each link: 9 parameters from input to hidden, 4 from hidden to output.

spec.title: 2–3–1 feedforward network
spec.aria: Two inputs feed three hidden units, which feed one output unit, with 6 weights plus 3 biases on the first link and 3 weights plus 1 bias on the second.
